image_description: A close-up portrait of a woman with wet, dark hair and glossy skin, blowing air to create soap bubbles. The background is a warm, golden-hued blur with numerous out-of-focus bubbles. Several sharp, iridescent bubbles are visible in the foreground and mid-ground, exhibiting rainbow coloration and transparency.
